item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Shocked Cat Monday Meme

turns.text: Make this a classic meme. Top: WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY. Bottom: BUT IT'S ONLY MONDAY. Big white letters with black outlines, keep it square and don't cover the cat's eyes. No full stops in the actual text.

item.tests: Tests exact top-and-bottom meme text, correct ordering, and legibility without obscuring the subject.

answer_sheet.Typography and punctuation: Classic meme styling: big uppercase white letters with black outlines. Keep the apostrophes, omit full stops.
answer_sheet.Picture and framing: Use cat-surprised.jpg, square, with the cat's eyes unobstructed.

must_haves: The top text reads exactly 'WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY', with no full stop.
The bottom text reads exactly 'BUT IT'S ONLY TUESDAY', with no full stop.
Both text blocks use large white uppercase letters with visible black outlines and fit entirely within the image.
The same shocked cat and sofa are retained, and neither eye is covered by text.
After the follow-up, the text reads exactly "BUT IT'S ONLY TUESDAY" where it read "BUT IT'S ONLY MONDAY"; everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually change the bottom text to "BUT IT'S ONLY TUESDAY" and keep everything else the same

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt:
Turn this supplied cat photo into a classic internet image macro meme. Preserve the photo and surprised cat appearance. Square composition. Add large bold condensed Impact-style ALL CAPS white lettering with thick black outlines, centered at the very top and bottom. Exact top caption: WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY
Exact bottom caption: BUT IT'S ONLY MONDAY
No full stops or other added punctuation. Apostrophes must be preserved. Wrap captions into two lines if needed for large readable lettering. Keep the top caption in the top area above the cat's eyes; keep bottom caption near bottom over couch/paws. Never cover either cat eye. Both eyes and surprised open mouth fully visible. No other text, no watermark.
